confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Split's summer (July) tourist pricing, not checked against live menus or booking listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely with season, location and availability. Hostel and hotel anchors are July peak-season estimates. Euro-based prices are converted at a rough EUR/USD assumption. The FX observation was taken from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page and was not verified against the F11 daily table. Third-party sites showed slightly different October rates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is Croatian Adriatic coastal cities with similar summer tourism, such as Zadar and Pula, adjusted toward Split's somewhat higher peak-season accommodation and dining prices. Dubrovnik was used as an upper-end reference only. Cocktail and wine anchors were set relative to beer, since direct knowledge of those prices is weaker.
